atAGlance: Miến xào cua is glass noodles stir-fried with crab, usually with sweet crab meat, egg, onion, herbs, and pepper.
whatItIs: Miến xào cua is glass noodles wok-tossed with crab, garlic, scallions, and the sweet juices from the crab. The noodles turn glossy as they soak up the seafood flavor.
howToEnjoy: Share it while hot, lifting the glass noodles gently so the crab stays distributed. Ask before ordering if you want to avoid shell pieces.
howLocalsOrder: Order miến xào cua as a shared crab noodle plate. Ask for less oil or less chili before the wok fires, and check whether the crab comes in shell.
worthKnowing: This is a celebratory seafood-noodle order in many Vietnamese restaurants because crab perfumes the whole plate.
goodToKnow: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
travelerCaution: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
